headline: Mooring Toehold Swept Away as Kuura Strand Front Cracks
war_summary: Since our last edition the map has shifted in the north. The Wind Hills, the Colonials' lone toehold in Mooring County, has fallen back to Warden hands, leaving that coast wholly theirs, and the fighting there has drawn blood at a fierce new rate. Kuura Strand has broken pattern as well: one of its six posts now lies in ruin, Talven and Faden Point still turning, with the latest movement logged as this edition went to press. The Weathered Expanse furnace burns on — forty-eight flag movements in a day and a further Warden post reduced to rubble, the count now five Warden to one Colonial with three grounds ruined. Marban Hollow has sprung back to life, Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall contested through seventeen movements, while the Nevish Line, after a flurry of fifty-four, sits oddly still, its newest flag some ten hours old. Linn Mercy grinds on at Outwich Ranch and Lathair, its tally unchanged, and Stlican Shelf stirs anew at Briar. Callahans Passage, for its part, has seen no flag stirred, though its casualty ledger swells apace. It is day 718; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize, and no victor is declared.
